statistics.latency_summary: completed trials with separate N; all-trial p95 null if rank exceeds completed N

scope: Offline injected responses; monotonic wall durations on actual product APIs. No curl, HTTP, Chrome, real TLS, real GeoIP or child processes.
scaling: Each timing override is explicit. These are accelerated scheduling fixtures, not proportional production latency predictions. SourceCache TTL remains its product default; warm cache priming is outside the collect component measurement (included in whole-trial elapsed/deadline).
unsupported: streaming feed end-to-end before a streaming injection seam exists
notes: Frozen before production behavior changes; revisions require new identity and rerunning both snapshots.
feed_* measures actual collect component, not future streaming pipeline success.
Repeated dead scan measures actual scan cost only; future history integration must be measured at Session/history admission too.
No success threshold is inferred from a baseline exhibiting the known defect. Findings are observations, not implementation acceptance.
Country Session uses a deterministic seeded shuffle scoped to that fixture; production randomization is unmodified on disk.
All endpoints below are inert fixture identities and must never be contacted.

Idle failure phase is validated against the first healthy completion anchor, actual elapsed interval fraction, no health in flight, and no intervening health start. Missed phase invalidates the trial; never counted as paired success.
